simple.prompt: Hedging with modal verbs: 'The initial findings ___ indicate a correlation between sleep quality and cognitive function.'
simple.explanation: 'May' melembutkan klaim (hedging) agar tidak terkesan overclaiming atau arogan tanpa bukti absolut.
hints: Gunakan modal pelembut klaim ilmiah.
Pilih 'may'.

simple.prompt: Hedging with probability adverbs: 'The economic downturn will ___ impact consumer discretionary spending.'
simple.explanation: 'Likely' menunjukkan probabilitas tinggi tanpa memutlakkan kepastian yang belum terjadi.
hints: Menunjukkan kemungkinan tanpa kepastian mutlak.
Gunakan 'likely'.

simple.targetSentence: Increased stress tends to impair immune system responsiveness.
simple.explanation: Increased stress + tends to impair + immune system responsiveness.
hints: Mulai dengan 'Increased stress'.
Frasa pelembut kecenderungan: 'tends to impair immune system responsiveness'.

simple.prompt: Hedging verbs: 'The preliminary survey results ___ that customer satisfaction has improved.'
simple.explanation: Dalam penulisan ilmiah, kata kerja seperti 'suggest', 'indicate', dan 'imply' jauh lebih disukai daripada klaim mutlak seperti 'prove definitively'.
hints: Kata kerja ilmiah untuk interpretasi data tentatif.
Gunakan 'suggest'.

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat hedging dengan 'It appears that'.
simple.targetSentence: It appears that the fiscal policy had a stabilizing effect.
simple.explanation: It appears that + the fiscal policy had a stabilizing effect.
hints: Mulai dengan pelembut: 'It appears that'.
Lanjutkan dengan 'the fiscal policy had a stabilizing effect'.

simple.prompt: Hedging with approximation: 'The laboratory observed a ___ increase in bacterial resistance.'
simple.explanation: 'Moderate' mengukur peningkatan secara proporsional dan terukur tanpa hiperbola.
hints: Kata sifat takaran terukur dan netral.
Gunakan 'moderate'.

simple.targetSentence: This strategy could possibly yield positive quarterly returns.
simple.explanation: This strategy + could possibly yield + positive quarterly returns.
hints: Mulai dengan 'This strategy'.
Pelembut probabilitas: 'could possibly yield positive quarterly returns'.

simple.prompt: In academic discussion, which hedged statement is most cautious and defensible?
options: Increased screen exposure may contribute to mild sleep disruption.
Increased screen exposure proves 100% that nobody sleeps properly.
Screen exposure always ruins every single teenager's health.
simple.explanation: Hedging memakai modal kehati-hatian seperti 'may' dan verb 'contribute to' untuk menghindari klaim absolut yang rentan dibantah oleh satu pengecualian.
hints: Hindari kata mutlak seperti '100%' dan 'always ... every single'.
Pilih klaim terukur dengan modal 'may'.

simple.prompt: The preliminary lab data ___ that solar roof coatings lower attic temperatures during peak summer.
simple.explanation: 'Suggest' atau 'indicate' adalah verb hedging standar dalam riset ketika temuan awal mendukung suatu kecenderungan tanpa mengklaim bukti mutlak final.
hints: Kata kuncinya 'preliminary lab data' (data awal).
Verb pelaporan hati-hati adalah 'suggests'.

simple.prompt: Smaller rural clinics ___ to rely heavily on mobile diagnostic vans during monsoon floods.
simple.explanation: Verb hedging 'tend to + V1' menyatakan kecenderungan umum yang sering terjadi namun tetap membuka ruang pengecualian.
hints: Menggambarkan kecenderungan umum tanpa memutlakkan.
'Tend to' adalah rumus hedging umum.

simple.prompt: ___ appears that afternoon traffic slows significantly near school zones.
simple.explanation: Introductory hedging impersonal berpola 'It appears that...' atau 'It seems likely that...' menjaga nada objektif dan tidak memaksa.
hints: Struktur awal hedging impersonal: 'It appears that...'.
Pilih subjek semu 'It'.

simple.prompt: Lengkapi percakapan akademik untuk melunakkan klaim yang terlalu mutlak.
dialogue: Advisor
You wrote 'Online quizzes completely eliminate math anxiety.' Isn't that too sweeping?
Student
Yes — let me soften it with an adverb: 'Online quizzes ___ reduce math anxiety for many learners.'
simple.explanation: Adverb hedging ('potentially', 'arguably', 'generally') memoderasi klaim agar sesuai dengan bukti empiris yang bervariasi antar-individu.
hints: Kita ingin melunakkan klaim, bukan membuatnya makin ekstrem.
Pilih adverb kehati-hatian 'potentially'.

simple.prompt: Notice how hedging uses adjectives of likelihood: 'A mild delay in sea freight is ___ during late-December typhoons.'
simple.explanation: Adjective hedging seperti 'likely', 'probable', atau 'plausible' menyampaikan kemungkinan beralasan tanpa mengklaim kepastian mutlak.
hints: Menyatakan kemungkinan yang tinggi namun tidak 100% pasti.
Pilih adjective probabilitas wajar 'probable / likely'.

simple.prompt: Perbaiki klaim berlebihan absolut (unhedged overstatement) pada kalimat kesimpulan riset berikut.
simple.draft: Every small café that installs solar panels definitely doubles its profit within three months.
options: Small cafés that install solar panels may gradually improve their operating margins over time.
Every small café that installs solar panels undoubtedly doubles its profit within three months.
No small café that installs solar panels ever fails to double its profit in three months.
simple.explanation: Kata mutlak seperti 'Every', 'definitely', dan 'within three months' hampir mustahil dipertahankan dalam jurnal ilmiah; ubah dengan modal 'may', adverb moderat 'gradually', dan cakupan wajar.
hints: Klaim 'Every ... definitely doubles' terlalu ekstrem dan rapuh.
Gunakan modal kehati-hatian 'may' dan frasa terukur.

simple.prompt: ___ speaking, participants in the morning cohort completed modules slightly faster.
simple.explanation: 'Generally speaking' atau 'Broadly speaking' berfungsi sebagai penanda cakupan umum (scope hedge) sebelum generalisasi statistik.
hints: Mengawali generalisasi dengan batas kewajaran.
Gunakan 'Generally'.

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat hedging memakai frasa pembuka impersonal 'It seems plausible that'.
simple.targetSentence: It seems plausible that brief afternoon breaks restore concentration during audits.
simple.explanation: Pola 'It seems plausible that...' menawarkan hipotesis secara ilmiah dan santun.
hints: Awali dengan 'It seems plausible that'.
Tambahkan klausa hipotesisnya.

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat hedging dengan verb 'indicate' dan modal 'could'.
simple.targetSentence: Early water readings indicate that minor filtration adjustments could boost clarity.
simple.explanation: Kombinasi verb berjarak 'indicate' dan modal 'could' menghasilkan dua lapis kehati-hatian akademik.
hints: Mulai dengan 'Early water readings indicate that'.
Lengkapi dengan 'minor filtration adjustments could boost clarity'.

intermediate.prompt: Lengkapi dialog revisi klaim overconfident dalam laporan riset.
dialogue: Advisor
Writing 'This discovery proves that genetics causes depression' is scientifically irresponsible.
Researcher
Understood. I will amend it to: 'These findings suggest that genetic factors ___ a role in depressive disorders.'
intermediate.explanation: 'May play a role' melembutkan klaim sebab-akibat absolut menjadi kontribusi yang masuk akal dan teruji.
hints: Bentuk pelembut baku keterlibatan faktor biologis.
Gunakan 'may play'.

intermediate.prompt: Impersonal epistemic hedging: '___ that dietary habits contribute to overall longevity.'
intermediate.explanation: Impersonal passive hedging ('It is widely assumed / believed / understood that...') mengalihkan klaim subjektif menjadi konsensus ilmiah objektif.
hints: Konstruksi pasif impersonal akademis.
Gunakan 'It is widely assumed'.

intermediate.prompt: Hedging frequency: 'Patients in this demographic ___ experience mild lethargy.'
intermediate.explanation: 'Frequently' menunjukkan pola berulang tanpa membuat generalisasi absolut yang berpotensi keliru.
hints: Frekuensi yang terukur dan tidak ekstrem.
Gunakan 'frequently'.

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat hedging akademik dengan 'To some extent'.
intermediate.targetSentence: To some extent the regulatory changes alleviated market anxieties.
intermediate.explanation: To some extent + the regulatory changes alleviated market anxieties.
hints: Mulai dengan pembatas klaim: 'To some extent'.
Klausa: 'the regulatory changes alleviated market anxieties'.

intermediate.prompt: Hedging epistemic distance: 'The author ___ to imply that monetary tightening was premature.'
intermediate.explanation: 'Seems / Appears + to-infinitive' memberikan jarak epistemik yang sopan dan terukur terhadap niat penulis lain.
hints: Memberikan jarak tafsir yang santun.
Gunakan 'seems'.

intermediate.targetSentence: In general higher interest rates dampen speculative investment activities.
intermediate.explanation: In general + higher interest rates dampen speculative investment activities.
hints: Mulai dengan pembatas umum: 'In general'.
Klausa ekonomi: 'higher interest rates dampen speculative investment activities'.

intermediate.prompt: Lengkapi dialog peer review artikel ekonomi.
dialogue: Reviewer
Can we conclude that tax cuts invariably stimulate entrepreneurship?
Author
No, empirical evidence indicates that the stimulative effect is ___ conditional on access to credit.
intermediate.explanation: 'Largely conditional on' membatasi validitas klaim agar bergantung pada variabel lain.
hints: Pembatas proporsionalitas klaim.
Gunakan 'largely'.

intermediate.prompt: Identify the sentence using RESTRICTIVE hedging (narrowing scope to the exact dataset/sample instead of claiming universal truth):
options: Within this sample of forty coastal clinics, flexible scheduling appeared to cut overtime by 12%.
Flexible scheduling unquestionably slashes overtime across every clinic worldwide.
It is an absolute certainty that overtime drops everywhere under flexible shifts.
intermediate.explanation: Mempersempit batas klaim ke kelompok spesifik ('Within this sample of forty coastal clinics') bersama 'appeared to' melindungi argumen dari sanggahan di luar konteks sampel.
hints: Cari kalimat yang membatasi ruang lingkup bukti dan memakai verb berhati-hati.
Frasa 'Within this sample...' membatasi generalisasi berlebih.

intermediate.prompt: There is ___ evidence to support the hypothesis that bilingual labeling speeds up warehouse sorting.
intermediate.explanation: Dalam laporan sains atau bisnis tahap awal, adjective seperti 'preliminary', 'tentative', atau 'emerging' menandai derajat bukti yang masih berkembang.
hints: Hedging terhadap kekuatan bukti saat ini.
'Preliminary' berarti awal/pendahuluan (terukur dan jujur secara ilmiah).

intermediate.prompt: Lengkapi percakapan antara editor jurnal dan peneliti tentang hedging berlebihan (hyper-hedging).
dialogue: Editor
Your sentence reads: 'It might perhaps possibly seem to suggest that noise could arguably affect sleep.' Is that good?
Researcher
Oops — piling up five hedges creates ___! One clear hedge like 'Noise may impair sleep' is far stronger.
options: awkward weakness and loss of authorial credibility
perfect grammatical precision for legal contracts
intermediate.explanation: Menumpuk 4–5 kata hedging sekaligus dalam satu klausa (compound hyper-hedging: 'might perhaps possibly seem to...') membuat penulis terkesan tidak percaya diri atas datanya sendiri.
hints: Hedging perlu keseimbangan: terlalu sedikit terasa arogan, terlalu banyak terasa ragu-ragu.
Hindari menumpuk banyak kata hedging di satu verb.

intermediate.prompt: Quantifiers of frequency like '___', 'frequently', or 'in many cases' hedge absolute generalizations without sounding weak.
intermediate.explanation: Mengganti 'always' menjadi frequency hedge seperti 'often' atau 'frequently' mengakui pola utama sambil tetap jujur terhadap pengecualian.
hints: Frequency hedge menggantikan kata mutlak 'always'.
'Invariably' masih bermakna mutlak tanpa pengecualian.

intermediate.prompt: To distance the claim objectively, academic writers often prefer 'Data from the regional survey ___ to show a gradual shift' over 'I think there is a shift.'
intermediate.explanation: 'Data ... appears to show' memindahkan fokus dari opini pribadi ('I think') ke interpretasi hati-hati berbasis bukti objektif.
hints: Hedging impersonal berbasis bukti data.
Pasangan infinitive dari 'to show' di sini adalah 'appears'.

intermediate.prompt: Sunting kesalahan menyamakan opini pribadi kasual dengan hedging akademik formal berikut.
intermediate.draft: In my humble opinion, I guess that electric ferries will kind of save coastal routes money eventually.
options: Current cost projections suggest that electric ferries could substantially reduce operating expenses along coastal routes.
Actually, I feel like electric ferries are definitely going to save coastal routes money for sure.
In my humble opinion, electric ferries sort of save coastal routes money maybe.
intermediate.explanation: Ungkapan percakapan seperti 'In my humble opinion', 'I guess', 'kind of', dan 'sort of' BUKAN hedging akademik; gunakan konstruksi berbasis bukti ('Current cost projections suggest... could...').
hints: Bedakan filler informal ('kind of', 'I guess') dari hedging akademik sejati.
Pilih kalimat berdasar proyeksi data dengan 'suggest' + 'could'.

intermediate.prompt: To ___ extent, public transit subsidies offset rising fuel expenses for suburban households.
intermediate.explanation: Frasa cakupan 'To some extent' atau 'To a considerable extent' secara presisi membatasi seberapa besar dampak sebab terhadap akibat.
hints: Ungkapan pembatas derajat dampak: 'To [adj] extent'.
'None' tidak cocok sebelum 'extent' tanpa 'To no extent'.

intermediate.prompt: This pricing discrepancy may, ___ part, reflect higher cold-chain insurance premiums this winter.
intermediate.explanation: Idiom tetap hedging yang membatasi sebab ('sebagian disebabkan oleh...') adalah 'in part' (setara 'partly').
hints: Frasa tetap bermakna 'sebagian': '... in part ...'.
Pilih preposisi 'in'.

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat hedging akademis memakai 'tend to' dan pembatas cakupan.
intermediate.targetSentence: Smaller retail shops tend to absorb shipping surcharges during holiday peaks.
intermediate.explanation: 'Tend to absorb' menyatakan kecenderungan umum yang terukur.
hints: Awali dengan 'Smaller retail shops tend to absorb'.
Tambahkan objek dan keterangan waktu.

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat dengan adverb hedging 'arguably' di posisi tengah kalimat.
intermediate.targetSentence: Clear onboarding documentation is arguably the most cost-effective way to lower support tickets.
intermediate.explanation: 'Arguably' mengakui bahwa klaim tersebut sangat masuk akal namun terbuka untuk perdebatan akademis.
hints: Mulai dengan 'Clear onboarding documentation is arguably'.
Lengkapi klausa superlatifnya.

complex.prompt: Koreksi klaim dogmatis tak berdasar ('bald assertions') agar memenuhi etika hedging akademik.
complex.draft: This experimental drug cures all known variations of the targeted influenza virus.
options: The clinical trials suggest that this drug exhibits substantial efficacy against several common variations of the targeted influenza virus.
This drug definitely cures all variations of the influenza virus.
There is complete proof that this drug cures all influenza variations.
complex.explanation: Etika akademik menolak klaim mutlak 'cures all known variations'. Versi yang telah di-hedge ('suggests', 'exhibits substantial efficacy', 'several common variations') menjaga kredibilitas dan keterbukaan ilmiah.
hints: Gunakan bahasa terukur dan berbobot tanpa overclaiming.
Pilih opsi pertama.

complex.prompt: Sociolinguistic purpose of hedging in scientific communities (Hyland, 1998):
options: To negotiate claims with peers by acknowledging alternative perspectives and protecting the researcher from reputational damage if findings are contested.
To ensure papers are rejected by prestigious journals.
complex.explanation: Hedging menurut teori Ken Hyland berfungsi sebagai instrumen negosiasi sosial antara peneliti dan komunitas sejawat untuk menghargai sudut pandang lain dan melindungi reputasi bila kelak data dikoreksi.
hints: Fungsi negosiasi klaim dan perlindungan reputasi akademik.
Pilih opsi negotiate claims with peers.

complex.prompt: Compound hedging (Shields + Approximators): Which sentence demonstrates sophisticated layered hedging?
options: It might be tentatively hypothesized that certain microeconomic factors could contribute to this trend.
This trend is caused by microeconomic factors.
Everyone knows microeconomic factors do this.
complex.explanation: Kalimat tersebut memadukan beberapa lapisan hedging secara harmonis: modal 'might', adverb 'tentatively', verb 'hypothesized', determiner 'certain', dan modal 'could contribute'.
hints: Memadukan beberapa lapisan pelembut klaim secara proporsional.
Pilih opsi pertama.

complex.prompt: Susun kalimat akademik dengan compound hedging.
complex.targetSentence: The available evidence tentatively suggests that the policy had a negligible impact.
complex.explanation: The available evidence + tentatively suggests that + the policy had a negligible impact.
hints: Mulai dengan bukti yang ada: 'The available evidence'.
Klausa pelembut: 'tentatively suggests that the policy had a negligible impact'.

complex.prompt: Perbaiki penggunaan hedging berlebihan (underclaiming/paralysis) yang merusak otoritas argumen.
complex.draft: It could perhaps maybe be possible that one might possibly consider looking at this data.
options: The data suggests an emerging correlation that warrants further empirical investigation.
Maybe perhaps we might look at this data if possible.
It could be possibly perhaps that we look at data.
complex.explanation: Hedging berlebihan (stacking unneeded hedges: could perhaps maybe possibly) mencerminkan kelemahan dan ketakutan tidak berdasar. Kalimat harus tetap tegas dan profesional: 'The data suggests an emerging correlation that warrants further empirical investigation'.
hints: Hilangkan keragu-raguan berlebihan dan pertahankan wibawa akademis.
Pilih 'The data suggests an emerging correlation that warrants further empirical investigation'.

complex.prompt: Hedging with restrictive clauses: 'The model holds true, ___ that boundary conditions remain undisturbed.'
complex.explanation: 'With the caveat that...' (dengan catatan/batasan bahwa...) adalah hedging formal untuk menetapkan limitasi teoretis.
hints: Frasa pembatas limitasi formal.
Gunakan 'with the caveat'.

dialogue: Examiner
Does your statistical model account for unobserved cultural variables?
Candidate
The model should be interpreted with caution, as it ___ unmeasured socio-cultural dynamics.
complex.explanation: 'May not fully capture' adalah respons hedging yang elegan dan jujur mengenai keterbatasan metodologi riset.
hints: Mengakui keterbatasan metodologi secara bermartabat.
Gunakan 'may not fully capture'.

complex.prompt: Distinguish Epistemic Hedging (knowledge uncertainty) from Affective/Polite Hedging in peer review: '___, the sample size in Table 2 appears slightly small to generalize nationally.'
complex.explanation: Dalam ulasan sejawat (peer review) atau kritik rapat profesional, perpaduan mitigasi sopan ('With due respect') atau adverb epistemik ('Arguably') + 'appears slightly' menyampaikan kritik tajam secara konstruktif tanpa menyerang pribadi.
hints: Nada ulasan sejawat menjaga kesantunan sekaligus presisi metodologis.
Hindari adverb emosional ekstrem atau absolut.

complex.prompt: When strategically combining two complementary hedges without creating clutter (e.g., modal + lexical verb), which pairing reads cleanest in Band 8+ writing?
options: These patterns would seem to indicate a gradual demographic shift.
These patterns maybe perhaps could possibly seem to kind of indicate a shift.
These patterns definitely must be indicating an absolute shift.
complex.explanation: Kombinasi elegan 'would seem to indicate' atau 'may suggest that' menciptakan jarak epistemik berlapis yang alami dan sering dipakai dalam jurnal ilmiah tanpa terasa berbelit.
hints: Satu kombinasi harmonis ('would seem to indicate') jauh lebih rapi daripada empat adverb menumpuk.
Bandingkan keterbacaan ketiga kalimat.

complex.prompt: Perbaiki ketidakcocokan antara klaim absolut di awal kalimat dan hedging di belakangnya (mixed register contradiction) berikut.
complex.draft: It is an indisputable universal fact that hybrid work may perhaps raise morale slightly for some employees.
options: Survey findings suggest that hybrid work policies may improve morale for a substantial share of employees.
It is an indisputable universal fact that hybrid work always raises morale for every employee.
Hybrid work sort of proves beyond any doubt that morale improves maybe.
complex.explanation: Menyatukan ungkapan mutlak ('indisputable universal fact') dengan 'may perhaps ... slightly' menimbulkan kontradiksi internal yang merusak kredibilitas tulisan; selaraskan nada di seluruh kalimat.
hints: Jangan mencampur kepastian mutlak dengan keraguan dalam satu klausa.
Samakan tingkat kepastian secara konsisten memakai 'suggest ... may'.

complex.prompt: Lengkapi percakapan tentang teori sosiolinguistik hedging dalam komunikasi ilmiah.
dialogue: Supervisor
Why do seasoned journal authors hedge even findings backed by p < 0.01 statistics?
Candidate
Because hedging leaves room for alternative interpretations while ___ against future falsification.
complex.explanation: Dalam wacana ilmiah modern (Hyland's hedging framework), hedging BUKAN tanda ketidaktahuan, melainkan strategi pelindungan klaim (shields/hedges) sekaligus bentuk kerendahan hati intelektual di depan komunitas riset.
hints: Ilmu pengetahuan selalu terbuka terhadap revisi di masa depan.
Hedging melindungi penulis agar klaimnya tetap akurat secara empiris.

complex.prompt: ___ as it may seem from short-term sales alone, rural micro-merchants adapted to QR codes faster than mid-sized wholesalers.
complex.explanation: Konstruksi konsesif-epistemik '[Adjective] as it may seem...' (bermakna 'Meskipun kelihatannya mengejutkan/paradoks...') adalah teknik hedging retoris tingkat lanjut sebelum menyajikan fakta tak terduga.
hints: Pola '[Adjective] as it may seem...' berfungsi sebagai pengantar kontras terukur.
Pilih 'Paradoxical / Surprising'.

complex.prompt: To distance yourself from an unverified external projection without calling it false, use the epistemic reporting frame: 'Government forecasts ___ project steady export growth through 2028.'
complex.explanation: 'Tentatively project' secara objektif menunjukkan bahwa proyeksi tersebut masih bersifat sementara dan dapat direvisi mengikuti perkembangan data.
hints: Adverb netral-objektif untuk perkiraan yang bisa berubah.
Pilih 'tentatively'.

complex.prompt: Sunting kesalahan menghilangkan kata hedging penting di kalimat yang mengubah hipotesis menjadi fakta pasti berikut.
complex.draft: If left unchecked, urban runoff is causing irreversible reef loss across the entire Pacific basin within five years.
options: If left unchecked, urban runoff could contribute to severe localized reef degradation over the coming decades.
If left unchecked, urban runoff will undoubtedly destroy every single Pacific reef in five years.
Urban runoff basically kinda harms reefs maybe.
complex.explanation: Mengganti prediksi mutlak dramatis ('is causing irreversible... entire Pacific basin within five years') dengan modal hati-hati ('could contribute to') dan cakupan akurat ('localized') menghasilkan prediksi ilmiah yang bertanggung jawab.
hints: Hindari klaim bencana total tanpa syarat batas geografis/waktu yang realistis.
Gunakan modal 'could' dan pembatas 'localized'.

complex.prompt: Look at 'presumably': 'The archive gate remained locked because the weekend custodian ___ assumed maintenance was still underway.' How does 'presumably' work?
options: It signals a reasonable inference rather than a confirmed eyewitness fact
It proves the author interviewed the custodian directly
It removes all time reference from Past Simple
complex.explanation: 'Presumably' (= agaknya / patut diduga) menyatakan kesimpulan masuk akal penulis tentang motivasi atau keadaan yang tidak diamati secara langsung.
hints: Adverb epistemik 'presumably' menandai asumsi logis.
Pilih deskripsi makna inferensial yang tepat.

complex.prompt: Susun kalimat hedging berlapis halus memakai pola 'would appear to'.
complex.targetSentence: Elevated night temperatures would appear to accelerate coastal coral bleaching.
complex.explanation: 'Would appear to + V1' adalah kombinasi modal dan verb persepsi yang sangat lazim dalam kesimpulan ilmiah.
hints: Awali dengan 'Elevated night temperatures would appear to'.
Tambahkan verb dasar 'accelerate' dan objeknya.

complex.prompt: Susun kalimat pembatas cakupan penelitian (restrictive hedging) untuk laporan hasil.
complex.targetSentence: While promising in pilot trials, these battery results cannot yet be extrapolated to sub-zero climates.
complex.explanation: Menyebut batas validitas riset ('pilot trials' vs 'sub-zero climates') menunjukkan ketelitian ilmiah tingkat tinggi.
hints: Mulai dengan 'While promising in pilot trials,'.
Jelaskan batas generalisasinya.
